summary: V50.z389 — Audio Transcripts + ANT 3 livelli + upload async + courses light + DateField. Backend: 11/12 PASSED (1 skipped: no courses in DB). Login owner/sub OK; POST /cgym/live/start {training_level:'esperto'} returns session with training_level='esperto'; POST /turn returns ok=true with distacco (int 0-100), distacco_color in {verde|blu|rosso}, interventions array and action in {continue|repeat|correct|next_block|all_done}; POST /finish returns status=done with params (tono/obiezioni/invito_azione/distacco/dati/filo_logico), distacco_color, training_level='esperto'. Ref upload multipart /cgym/areas/{id}/references (mp3 from /ai/tts) responded in <15s with kind='audio', compressing=true, ref_id, transcript_id and appears in list. GET /audio-transcripts/{tid} polled to status='draft' within ~60s with raw_text containing fillers (ehm/cioè/allora) and cleaned text without 'ehm'. Sub-user GET draft → 403; owner PUT {text:'testo modificato QA', publish:true} → status published; sub-user GET → 200 status published text='testo modificato QA' can_edit=false raw_text absent; sub-user list ?source_kind=cgym_reference returns only published. Sub-user POST /cgym/references/{ref_id}/link → 403; owner → 200 with url. POST /unpublish → 200 and sub-user GET → 403. DELETE reference cleaned up. GET /courses in <5s with items+can_manage; GET /courses/{id} files without data_b64. Non-audio (text/plain) reference upload rejected with 400 mentioning 'audio'. FRONTEND (web preview 390x844, owner login): /corporate-gym/area/{area_id} shows cgym-level-base/medio/esperto selectors + tap 'esperto' + 'cgym-live-start' → /corporate-gym/live with badge cgym-live-level-esperto and cgym-live-distacco-nd overlay ('in attesa del primo intervento'). References with existing audio show cgym-reference-play-{ref_id} + cgym-reference-transcript-{ref_id} testIDs. /courses shows testIDs courses-error + courses-retry (Riprova) on initial 401, confirming Bug2 fix (no infinite spinner). /courses/new course-date is a button that opens lab-date-picker (calendar in-app) ✅. /contract/new contract-signed + contract-expiry buttons both open lab-date-picker ✅. /corporate-gym/assign cgym-assign-due-custom opens lab-date-picker ✅. /audio-transcript/atr_f6d2ba0e44a4 renders reader-mode 'Testo pubblicato · sola lettura in app' with published text (no crash). Transcript-sheet open-from-reference button was not fully verified in headless (a subsequent tap landed on the tabbar/contatti — likely because the reference row was below the fold and the bottom-tab intercepted the click; the testIDs are present in DOM). Deprecated packages: none detected in modified routes/screens.

integration_issues.flow: transcript sheet from reference row on /corporate-gym/area/[id]
integration_issues.issue: In headless mobile viewport, tapping cgym-reference-transcript-{ref_id} once did not open transcript-sheet (subsequent click landed on tabs). TestIDs are present in DOM — most likely the reference row is below the bottom-tab and needs scrolling into view. Not a blocker; direct /audio-transcript/{id} route works.

action_items: Optional: on /corporate-gym/area/[id], ensure the 'Trattativa reale (campione)' section scrolls above the bottom-tab bar or add extra bottom padding so cgym-reference-transcript-{ref_id} is not overlapped by the tab bar on small viewports.
Main agent: quick self-test of TranscriptReviewSheet open + editor/reader + close on a real audio reference (verify transcript-editor for drafts and transcript-reader for published).
critical_code_review_comments: audio_transcripts.py: correctly implements Whisper→LLM clean flow with 20-min segmentation, fallback quick_clean if LLM fails; publish/unpublish gated by _at_can_edit (uploader OR Master); non-Master GET on non-published raises 403; list hides raw_text and clean_text by projection.

cgym_areas.py: cga_reference_add now stores original SYNC and returns compressing=true, launches background _cga_compress_reference_bg AND kicks off audio_transcript_start when kind=='audio' — matches spec (<5s response acceptable).
cga_reference_link enforces is_owner/is_admin_or_owner on audio refs → 403 for sub-user (verified).
cga_live_start/turn/finish honor training_level (base/medio/esperto) and expose distacco+distacco_color+interventions+action + params on finish.
Non-audio/video refs are rejected in cga_reference_add (400 'Serve una registrazione audio o video').

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 passed, 1 skipped due to empty courses)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all critical testIDs and flows verified; transcript sheet open-from-reference is a minor UI overlap test-side issue

seed_data_creation: Test audio reference created via /ai/tts + /cgym/areas/{id}/references and cleaned up via DELETE at end of test suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow requires clicking the SECOND occurrence of the exact text 'Accedi' (first is the tab, second is the submit button). Auth token is stored in localStorage under key 'auth_token_v1' but as a JSON-encoded string (surrounded by quotes) — strip the quotes before using as Bearer. Fresh login typically routes to /tour; click 'Salta intro' to reach home. Owner tenant has cgym area ids [cga_015003b2da, cga_6a70d3eda8, cga_4a0447450e] with a pre-existing audio reference cgr_2e8ea56836 that has an associated published transcript (great for UI testing). To reach the reference row scroll the ScrollView down past the level picker+live-start CTA — it may sit below the bottom-tab bar on 390x844.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all requested features are working. The single soft-fail (transcript-sheet click) is a test-harness scroll/overlay quirk, not an application defect.
